title: The Time Variation in Risk Appetite and Uncertainty
authors: Geert Bekaert A; Eric C. Engstrom; Nancy R. Xu
eligible_reason: Asset-pricing paper: GMM estimation of a dynamic no-arbitrage model with time-varying risk aversion and uncertainty, aggregate time series. No treatment/DiD design.
design_notes: MATLAB GMM and filtering code (qt_gmm_stage1/2, code_industrialestimation, code_external_validation.m). No regression of a binary treatment on a panel.
data_files_note: readme.txt documents raw sources (FRED, NBER, market data) and intermediate .mat files.
screener_notes: Published PDF text read; no DiD/event-study terms. Out of scope.
